change: IVSR-PTRADD-1: teach the pointer-recurrence scan the address-forming Add that LCCC's own lowering emits for every C subscript
metric: Callgrind Ir for bench_run, per kernel. Deterministic and reproducible; NOT cycles, uops, PMU counters or a Raptor Lake measurement.
why_not_wall_clock: scripts/bench_kernels.py reported 7 of 11 kernels moving beyond its 3% tolerance with BYTE-IDENTICAL codegen on this host - a ~15% layout-noise floor. A runtime delta inside that band is unmeasurable here, so Ir is the decision metric.
correctness: all 11 kernels: pre/post/gcc checksums identical (the driver's checksum is derived from the whole computation, so a different answer is a failure, not a win)

ilp32_gate.reason: the recurrence adds a loop-carried pointer web; on a 6-GPR file it is parked in a slot at the latch - the documented cost that keeps CCC_IVSR_SCALAR_DERIVED opt-in
ilp32_gate.measured_without_gate: tests/regression/simd_crc_adler.c -O2 -m32 grew 142 -> 191 stack refs (+49) for +2 instructions, while the same source on x86-64 was +2 insns / -1 stack
ilp32_gate.effect_of_gate: every -m32 difference disappeared; 18 changed files fell to 6
ilp32_gate.correctness_on_ilp32: unchanged - tests/regression/ivsr_address_add.c runs and passes on -m32 at -O0..-O3

rejected_this_round.proposal: collapse c ? K : (c2 ? K : Y) to (c|c2) ? K : Y over boolean Select chains - the shape C's a||b||c takes after if-conversion
rejected_this_round.static: k_classify bench_run 49 -> 48 instructions; the OR chain replaced two cmovs
rejected_this_round.measured: classify Callgrind Ir 5,962,067 -> 6,118,811 (+2.63%); namechars unchanged; total suite -0.49% -> -0.27%
rejected_this_round.verdict: REVERTED. Fewer static instructions, MORE executed instructions: the folded form makes every term unconditional. Reverted byte-identically (cmp against the pre-fold build).
rejected_this_round.remaining_gap_it_does_not_close: k_classify is still 2.057x GCC and k_namechars 1.653x. The residual cost is backend boolean materialisation, not IR shape: each setcc is followed by a redundant movzbl AND a movsbq/movsbl of the same byte, and the surviving Select still costs movl $1 / movq / cmovneq. That is a register-allocation and copy-coalescing problem (RA-CSAVE-1 class), and folding at the IR level cannot reach it.

host: Debian 13 VM, Xeon, GCC 14.2, binutils 2.44, Rust 1.99.0, 8 GiB swap, valgrind 3.24.0
not_measured: the slow/benchmark CI gates (out of scope by explicit instruction)
